stories.title: Review the checkout total before paying
stories.outcome: Shoppers can verify delivery charges and the full order total before submitting payment.

stories.title: Track an order without creating an account
stories.outcome: Guest shoppers can follow delivery progress using their order confirmation.
stories.decision: Product owner to choose whether guest tracking includes split shipments in this scope.

stories.title: Retry a failed payment safely
stories.outcome: Shoppers can recover from a payment failure without placing a duplicate order.

stories.title: Choose express checkout for a repeat purchase
stories.outcome: Returning shoppers can reuse a preferred delivery option while confirming the final total.
stories.decision: Product owner to decide whether saved payment methods are included or deferred.

stories.title: Receive a clear order confirmation
stories.outcome: Shoppers receive a confirmation showing purchased items, delivery details and the total paid.

stories.title: Correct a delivery address during checkout
stories.outcome: Shoppers can correct invalid address details without losing their basket.

stories.title: Understand why a payment was declined
stories.outcome: Shoppers receive a useful next step without exposing sensitive payment details.

availability.summary: Simulated production outage: Zava Shop checkout and payment submission are unavailable in this fictional observation. Window-wide request and log metrics are independent historical samples.

logs.message: Synthetic retry observation: payment authorization recovered after a transient response.
Synthetic exception observation: checkout validation could not complete.
Synthetic dependency observation: delivery status lookup used a cached response after a timeout.
Synthetic dependency observation: payment authorization returned an unsuccessful response.
Synthetic performance observation: checkout processing exceeded the local warning threshold.
Synthetic recovery observation: confirmation rendering returned to its expected latency range.

definitions.activeUsers: Distinct fictional shoppers who browsed a product, saved a basket or placed an order during the weekly period; this is an authored sample.
definitions.activation: New eligible shoppers in the current week who reached first value by saving a basket with a selected delivery option; activated shoppers are included in active users.
definitions.retention: The 800-shopper cohort selected from baseline-period active users, of whom 560 returned for a qualifying activity in the current period. Sampled value outcomes below are separately authored observations, not inferred from these usage counts.

business.scopeNote: Complete authored weekly business sample for fictional Zava Shop, not a connected report or the entire business. Values are independent observations and do not establish attribution to application behavior.

metrics.name: Weekly order value
metrics.definition: Authored sample of submitted Zava order merchandise value during the week, before refunds and excluding delivery charges.

metrics.name: Weekly submitted orders
metrics.definition: Authored count of distinct submitted Zava orders in the weekly sample, not distinct shoppers or payment requests.

metrics.name: Median fulfillment cycle
metrics.definition: Separately authored median elapsed time from order submission to dispatch among dispatched orders in the Zava weekly sample.

metrics.name: On-time fulfillment
metrics.definition: Separately authored percentage of sampled Zava dispatched orders meeting their promised dispatch date during the week.
